CustomField.description: The pluggability pivot: the Apex class name resolved at runtime to fetch the feed. Stub provider today, ASB provider once the spoke exists - a config change, not a rebuild. A class named only by a config string can be deleted without a compile error, so an unresolvable name must HALT rather than silently fall back to the stub. There is no hardcoded fallback in Apex: if this is unset the run halts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Apex class that fetches the feed. An unknown name halts the run - it does not fall back.
CustomField.label: Provider Class Name
